title: AIR Source and Control Registry
description: Referential AIR registry for selecting the smallest sufficient source and control bundle by artifact class, domain, authority, freshness, scope, risk, access/licence, quorum, fallback and retrieval stop state. It preserves local-file-native operation and does not grant autonomous retrieval authority, Orbit 0 governance, backend enforcement, cryptographic proof, or completion by source reference.

domain_adapter_contract.input: domain ids or AIR_SESSION_DOMAIN_OVERLAY source requirements
domain_adapter_contract.output: source/control bundle candidates and authority/freshness/access requirements
domain_adapter_contract.boundary: Domain Capability Registry identifies subject-domain needs; this registry owns source/control route metadata. Neither absorbs the other.

rules: Every source states what it can support and what it cannot prove.
Unknown licence/access blocks reuse claims but may permit bounded citation-only use when lawful.
Hosted sources and tools remain optional unless separately approved.
A source entry never grants autonomous retrieval authority.

control_entry_contract.rule: A written control definition is not proof that the control ran.

bundle_contract.selection_rule: Select the smallest bundle satisfying mandatory floors, artifact class, domain, risk, evidence and active-contract requirements.

SYSTEM_PROMPT_OR_CORE_CONTROL.minimum_authority_rule: Local hash-confirmed sources plus governing approval/evidence; external standards only when claims require them.

SPECIALIST_CAPABILITY_PROFILE.minimum_authority_rule: At least one official/primary source for material external claims; source-light mode must remain degraded.

DOMAIN_REGISTRY_OR_PACKAGE.minimum_authority_rule: Domain routes may be declared before retrieval, but grounded claims require role coverage.

METHOD_PACK.minimum_authority_rule: A written procedure is not execution evidence.

EXECUTOR_CONTRACT.minimum_authority_rule: Interface docs plus observed tests; no executor approval from docs alone.

POLICY_OR_EVALUATION_PACK.minimum_authority_rule: Test definitions and executed evidence remain separate.

required_roles: current user source truth or local file
one authoritative supporting source when external facts are material
LOW_RISK_SOURCE_LIGHT.minimum_authority_rule: One source may suffice only when consequence and uncertainty are low.

selection_algorithm: Bind active contract, artifact class, domain, task envelope, risk and claim type.
Identify mandatory controls and quorum profile.
Prefer confirmed local sources and official or primary sources.
Exclude or block prohibited, inaccessible, stale, incompatible or licence-unclear routes; preserve degraded citation-only state when lawful.
Retrieve or inspect until quorum is met or a stop condition fires.
Record evidence classes and claim boundaries separately from source references.
Return route, quorum, retrieval, fallback, blockers and next allowed action.

ordered_fallbacks: confirmed local AIR files and explicit user source truth
dependency_sovereignty: No package manager, plugin, hosted service, API or network source is mandatory for baseline AIR operation.
Optional tools may strengthen evidence but cannot redefine doctrine or erase degraded state.

stop_conditions: licence or access gap requires review
tool or network unavailable and local fallback selected
must_not: continue only to increase source count
treat secondary discovery support as authority when an official source is required

claim_boundaries: Source references support routing and reasoning; they do not prove execution or completion.
OFFICIAL_SOURCE_VERIFIED means the official page was observed, not that all downstream content is correct or reusable.
TOOL_OBSERVED_RESULT requires an actual tool run and captured evidence.
Backend-enforced and cryptographic states require independent evidence and are never inferred from this registry.
Licence/access classification is source-specific information, not legal advice.
